definitions: Medication administered by a route other than the digestive tract, typically by injection (intravenous, intramuscular, subcutaneous, etc.).
A drug or solution delivered directly into the body, bypassing the gastrointestinal system.
examples: The nurse prepared the parenteral medication for injection.
Parenteral medication is often used for patients who cannot take oral drugs.
Proper aseptic technique is crucial when administering parenteral medication.
